metadata.title: Pride and Prejudice: Darcy's Rain Confession
metadata.source: Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen, Chapter 34

global.style_description: Semi-realistic anime with cinematic lighting, detailed character art, period-accurate Regency costumes, atmospheric rain effects, emotional facial expressions. Style influenced by Makoto Shinkai (atmospheric rain), 2005 Pride & Prejudice film (period accuracy), Studio Ghibli (detailed backgrounds).
global.negative_prompts: modern clothing, modern hairstyles, modern makeup, modern accessories, smartphone, laptop, contemporary furniture, electric lights, wrong period costume, wrong hairstyle, text, watermark, signature, logo, UI elements, sunlight, direct sun, warm lighting, candles, fire in fireplace, clear sky, sunny, no rain, dry, snow, fog, face changes, different face, morphing face, inconsistent face, wrong eye color, wrong hair color, costume changes, extra fingers, deformed hands, deformed face, blurry face, low quality, blurry, out of focus, pixelated, artifacts, cartoon, photorealistic, 3D render, CGI
global.lighting: Overcast gray light, diffused, soft shadows, no direct sunlight, no artificial light, cool blue-gray color temperature
global.weather: Rain throughout scene, varying intensity: gentle (Beat 1), heavy (Beat 2-3), storm (Beat 4), softer (Beat 5)
global.location: Hunsford Parsonage, modest sitting room, Regency era (early 1810s), small room with two chairs, writing desk, unlit fireplace, large window with rain visible

elizabeth_bennet.name: Elizabeth Bennet
elizabeth_bennet.appearance: Oval face, dark brown wavy hair partially down, dark brown eyes bright and expressive, fair complexion, full lips, slender build 5'4", upright posture
elizabeth_bennet.costume: Modest blue-gray empire-waist Regency gown, short puffed sleeves, floor-length skirt, light wool shawl, minimal jewelry, flat slippers
elizabeth_bennet.emotional_arc: Surprise → Shock → Anger → Explosive refusal → Exhaustion

mr_darcy.name: Fitzwilliam Darcy
mr_darcy.appearance: Strong jawline, dark brown/black hair thick and damp, dark intense eyes, fair complexion, athletic build 6'0", rigid upright posture
mr_darcy.costume: Dark blue or black wet tailcoat (dripping from rain), cream waistcoat, white high-collared shirt, white cravat, light-colored trousers, black Hessian boots (wet), leather gloves (removed)
mr_darcy.emotional_arc: Intense struggle → Desperate vulnerability → Defensive pride → Shocked humiliation → Controlled devastation

shots.prompt: Semi-realistic anime, cinematic, 16:9 aspect ratio. Wide shot of modest Regency-era parsonage sitting room, late afternoon, overcast gray light through large window. Rain streaks on window glass. Small room with two chairs, writing desk with books, unlit fireplace. Wooden floor with worn rug. Muted colors: cool grays, soft browns, blue-gray. Atmospheric, melancholic beauty. No people visible. 3 seconds.
shots.negative_prompt: modern furniture, electric lights, sunlight, fire in fireplace, people, text, watermark, low quality
